# Phase 1 Pipeline — Databricks Cluster Run

Run this notebook on Databricks cluster. Scripts sourced from workspace path.
For local runs, use `00. MASTER_RUN.R` instead.

```{r setup}
# Databricks workspace path to Codes/ folder
CODES_PATH <- "/Workspace/Users/tajayalath@ua.edu/Drought-indices/files/Codes"
```

```{r packages}
# SPEI installed as cluster library via Databricks UI (Libraries tab).
# No install.packages needed — cluster carries it across all runs.
stopifnot(requireNamespace("SPEI", quietly = TRUE))
message("SPEI available on cluster.")
```

```{r run-flags}
RUN_SPI        <- FALSE  # Script 01: SPI calculation — DONE with country fix 2026-05-04
RUN_SPEI_T     <- TRUE   # Script 02a: water_balance column added 2026-05-06
RUN_SPEI_P     <- TRUE   # Script 02b: water_balance column added 2026-05-06
RUN_DETECTION  <- TRUE   # Script 03: pixel_freq_ref.rds block added 2026-05-06
RUN_SANITY     <- FALSE  # Script 04: Sanity checks — DONE 2026-05-05
RUN_REF_PARAMS <- TRUE   # Script 05: log-logistic fix + SPI-12 coverage 2026-05-06
RUN_FRIEDMAN   <- TRUE   # Script 06: spatial + stratified Friedman added 2026-05-06
RUN_CROSSPERIOD <- TRUE  # Script 07: tie correction + severity sign fix 2026-05-06
RUN_APPENDIX   <- TRUE   # Script 08: Severe color fix 2026-05-06
RUN_CDD_COMP   <- TRUE   # Script 09: new script, first run 2026-05-06
```

```{r step1-spi}
if (RUN_SPI) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 1: SPI Calculation")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "01. SPI_Calculation.R"))
}
```

```{r step2a-spei-thornthwaite}
if (RUN_SPEI_T) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 2a: SPEI Calculation — Thornthwaite PET")
  message("================================================================")
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02a. SPEI_Calculation_Thornthwaite.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      err_msg <- paste0(
        "SCRIPT 02a ERROR at ", Sys.time(), "\n",
        conditionMessage(e), "\n",
        paste(capture.output(traceback()), collapse = "\n")
      )
      writeLines(err_msg, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/script02a_error.txt")
      message("ERROR WRITTEN TO VOLUME: script02a_error.txt")
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}
```
